name: Inteligencia competitiva
description: Escanear señales públicas y sintetizar un brief de competidores.
briefPrompt:
Produce a Competitive Intelligence Brief for the company, product, or market in context.

Workflow:
1) Research — dated public signals (product, pricing, GTM, hiring, partnerships).
2) Analyst — synthesize.

Required sections:
## Thesis
## Competitor / market signals (dated + links)
## Business read (positioning, threats, opportunities)
## Options (2–3 moves)
## Recommendation
## Next actions
## References

Separate Fact vs Inference vs Recommendation. Do not invent URLs.

name: Q&A de políticas y conocimiento
description: Recuperar documentos internos y responder con recomendaciones.
briefPrompt:
Answer using the internal knowledge base first for the policy, process, or FAQ in context.

If documents are thin, say what is missing. End with a clear recommendation and cite retrieved sources when available.

Required sections:
## Answer
## Evidence (from knowledge base)
## Gaps / assumptions
## Recommendation
## Next actions
